trigger_condition: When pdf.worker.min.mjs fails to load with JS MIME type (e.g. text/html SPA fallback, strict proxy .mjs MIME mismatch, subpath deployment mismatch, or CSP worker-src block). Local Vite dev & vite preview pass with 200 text/javascript.
observed_behavior_and_error: All PDF.js operations fail because pdfjs-dist v6 dynamic fake-worker import also fails ('Setting up fake worker failed: Failed to fetch dynamically imported module'). Mandatory verifyPdfOutputIntegrity(verifyWithPdfJs=true) turns this into ERR_OUTPUT_INTEGRITY across every PDF-writing tool as well.
minimal_remediation: Import worker via Vite ?url (import workerUrl from 'pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs?url') or serve via same-origin .js asset / Blob shim with explicit MIME headers; avoid throwing fatal ERR_OUTPUT_INTEGRITY when worker bootstrap fails while magic/EOF/pdf-lib checks succeed.

trigger_condition: Uploading valid .webp, .svg, .gif, or .bmp image files (explicitly allowed by <input accept> and advertised by error catalog).
observed_behavior_and_error: Rejected at execution with ERR_UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE_FORMAT: 'Invalid or unsupported image file ... Unsupported or corrupted image signature (expected PNG 89 50 4E 47 or JPEG FF D8 FF)'.
minimal_remediation: Either rasterize WebP/SVG/GIF/BMP via OffscreenCanvas/HTMLCanvasElement to PNG/JPEG before embedding in convertImagesToPdfV2
column9: or restrict IMAGE_ACCEPT and error text strictly to .png

affected_scope: pdf-ocr; pdf-to-text (OCR fallback); PDF converters (OCR fallback)
trigger_condition: Running OCR in offline, firewalled, or strict CSP environments without external CDN access.
observed_behavior_and_error: Online Chromium test passes, but Tesseract createWorker() fetches worker.min.js, wasm core, and traineddata from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net despite local tesseract.js dist files in node_modules.
minimal_remediation: Configure local bundled workerPath/corePath (from tesseract.js/dist or Vite ?url imports) and surface explicit network/CDN error guidance for language traineddata downloads.

trigger_condition: Opening /categories/pdf-tools or rendering catalog lists keyed by calculator.id.
observed_behavior_and_error: pdf-tools registers 34 entries for 33 unique IDs; two 'PDF Metadata Editor' cards render on /categories/pdf-tools and risk React duplicate-key collisions.
minimal_remediation: Remove the duplicate pdf-metadata-editor entry from batch82d_group6.ts (or phase25_pdf_tools_expansion.ts) and add a catalog uniqueness guard.

affected_scope: pdf-extractor-merger; pdf-reorder-pages; pdf-page-reordering-tool; pdf-extract-pages; pdf-delete-pages; pdf-merge; pdf-comparison; pdf-protect-password; pdf-remove-password
trigger_condition: Clicking enabled 'Process PDF Document' immediately after uploading without filling ranges, selecting all pages for reorder, uploading 2nd file, or entering password.
observed_behavior_and_error: Workspace submits and displays [role='alert'] errors. Notably pdf-extractor-merger sets minFiles=1 in pdfRegistry.ts:100 yet 1-file submit without range emits 'PDF Merge requires at least 2 input PDF files (received 1)'.
minimal_remediation: Disable submit button or show inline validation helper when required inputs are incomplete; update pdf-extractor-merger single-file-no-selection error to instruct user to select pages or add a 2nd PDF.

trigger_condition: Uploading a valid application/pdf file with no .pdf filename extension (or inspecting upload-time MIME validation).
observed_behavior_and_error: DocumentConvertersWorkspace rejects extensionless application/pdf files immediately at upload ('Unsupported or empty file... matching: .pdf') without inspecting MIME or magic bytes; PdfToolsWorkspace skips thumbnails when filename lacks .pdf and skips upload-time validation.
minimal_remediation: Check file.type or first 1 KB magic header (%PDF- / PK) alongside filename extension in DocumentConvertersWorkspace and PdfToolsWorkspace thumbnail eligibility.

column11: Uploading a valid password-protected PDF to any PDF-to-Office/HTML/Markdown/CSV converter.
column12: Fails with 'Conversion error This PDF is password-protected. Please provide the document password to proceed.', with no password input field in DocumentConvertersWorkspace UI and no password forwarded to pdfjsLib.getDocument().
column13: Add optional PDF password input in DocumentConvertersWorkspace when contract input is PDF and pass password through ConversionOptions into extractPdfContent().

trigger_condition: Uploading a valid OpenDocument Spreadsheet (.ods) ZIP archive containing content.xml + mimetype but omitting META-INF/manifest.xml.
observed_behavior_and_error: Fails with 'Conversion error Unsupported ZIP file' from SheetJS XLSX.read(), whereas odt-to-pdf-converter and odp-to-pdf-converter parse content.xml via JSZip directly and succeed.
minimal_remediation: Add JSZip content.xml fallback parser for .ods when SheetJS XLSX.read throws 'Unsupported ZIP file' (matching ODT/ODP architecture).

affected_scope: Legacy pdf-duplicate-pages branch & dual pdf-lib dependency
trigger_condition: Navigating to /calculator/pdf-duplicate-pages or auditing bundle dependencies.
observed_behavior_and_error: /calculator/pdf-duplicate-pages returns 'Calculator Not Found' while PdfToolsWorkspace retains a dead V1 branch importing pdfCoreEngine.ts and legacy pdf-lib@1.17.1 alongside @cantoo/pdf-lib@2.11.1.
minimal_remediation: Migrate duplicate-pages cleanly if needed or remove the unreachable V1 branch and unused pdf-lib@1.17.1 duplicate dependency.
